punchline: In Carabayllo, MDR-TB treatment was carried up the hill by neighbors in backpacks.
thirty_sec: Socios En Salud, founded 8 July 1996 in Carabayllo north of Lima, treated MDR-TB when the global community called it too expensive, using locally hired community health workers; PIH reports over 10,500 treated and an 83 percent cure rate.
question: Who stands closest to the people you are trying to reach, and is that person part of your plan?
key_contrast: Give the last stretch to people who live there, not to headquarters.
